tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmar chen gtor bzlog gi phyag len grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i phyag bris dngos sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas zhal zhus bgyis pa bzhugs so// sog bzlog hor bzlog sogs bstan pa spyi'i rim gro la dmigs nas byed dgos shar tshe/ dam rdzas lnga'am bdun/ bskang gtor rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ rgyag gtor mgon po/ zhal/ pu tra/ bdud rgyal/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams bzo lugs/ zor gtor dkyus ma lugs kyi rgyu 'khor/ skyer tshangs/ tshe dang / yungs kar sogs kyi bsgang bu/ thod skam/ mgon po la gtor dar sngon po rnams la/ sgrig pa ni sgrub gtor gyi mdun du bzhag cing / sbyangs bdug gtor kha gso ba rnams kyang bskang gso bzhin byas pa'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams bshams la/ chog sgrig gzhan maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod sogs dus mdos bzhin spyan ras gzigs dang / dzaṃ gtor sogs mi mdzad pa/ snga dro dkar chab rkyang pa mdzad kyang 'thus/ yang yongs rdzogs mdzad kyang yong / zhu 'bul sogs dus mdos bzhin/ mol gtam mi dgos/ nyi ma gnyis la gtor 'bul dkyus bzhin dpon slob tshang ma bzhugs nas mdzad/ rjes chog dus mdos bzhin/ tshugs pa'i dgong bskang gso nag po mchod rten/ bstod pa rab 'bar ma la dbyangs res mi mdzad par dkyus bzhin mdzad/ tshogs 'khor mdzad mi mdzad gang bde/ mdzad pa shar na lhag gtor gyi mjug tu gtor 'bul dang / mi mdzad na dkyus bzhin/ ༈ /nyi ma bar ma la cho ga tshar gnyis mdzad pa shar na/ snga dro bskang gso gsar pa dang / bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma/ dgong mo nag po mchod rten dang sangs rgyas bstan srung ma rgyas pa/ ༈ /cho ga tshar gcig mdzad pa shar tshe/ gsol gong du bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ gtor bsngo/ bshags pa tshar gsum bzhengs bzhugs gang rung mdzad rjes/ lha zhal pu tra dkar mo ba rgyas pa sogs bskang gso tshes thogs hrug pa re mdzad rjes/ bstod pa gang thugs ma/

mi pham ma/ rdo rje 'chang dbang ma rnams mdzad/ bzlog pa'i rjes su drag bskul rnams tshar re yang mdzad do/ ༈ /gtor ma rgyag pa'i nyin cho ga thams cad gsol gong du grub pa mdzad/ de nas ji ltar rigs par rnga gral sgrigs/ dus mdos lugs bzhin la/ sngags dbyangs ni thog mar shā sa na'i sngags dbyangs dang / rol mo nyis brdeg ring ba'i mjug tu/ gnod sbyin gyi 'gyings dbyangs tshig gnyis la dus mdos lugs kyi tshig dang po la hor bzlog 'chams sku mgon po phebs/ tshig gnyis pa la lha mo phebs/ spyad bgrad sogs tshig gnyis dang / yum gyi tshigs bcad gnyis rnams 'dur ma mdzad cing / rol mo ma slangs pa pu tra'i 'cham dbyangs dang bstun/ 'cham sku mkhas btsun chen po'i thugs ma phebs/ sgar dbyangs grub mtshams/ bha tra/ sring mo/ sgo ma rnams la tshig bcad re re/ bsad pa'i sha dang sogs thun mong tshig bcad gcig rnams 'dur ma byas rjes rol mo gsum brdeg lan can gyi mjug tu chig brdung dal bu'i 'gro zhing / ji ltar rigs pa nas rol mo bzhi 'gros su bsgyur cing / ji ltar rigs pa'i sar rol mo sum brdeg lan bcas kyi rjes su/ spyi btab dbyangs gcig 'dur ma rnams drug cu pa lugs bzhin gyi rjes su gson dang sogs drag bskur rnams yongs rdzogs song rjes/ rol mo bzhi 'gros ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su lan bcas dang / drug cu pa bzhin dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i mjug tu dgu brdung dang / de nas bzhi 'gros kyis ngang nas gtor ma rgyag sar slebs pa na/ rol mo nyis rdeg lan bcas byas la/ zor las pa rnams dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i bar la sngon la phyin nas/ gser skyems dpang gzugs grub pa byas/ de nas dpon slob thams cad phyogs mthun du pho nya bskul/ dus mdos lugs bzhin gyi rjes su gtor ma rnams 'phang / de nas ji ltar rigs pa'i sar srid zhi dpal 'byor sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas pa mdzad cing /

'cham sku rnams so so la mi cha la phebs pa dus mdos sgra ji bzhin pa dgos so/ /gnod sbyin rnams mi dgos/ zhes pa 'di ni sa pho rta lo sog bzlog gnang dus/ chog sgrigs 'di rnams shar rgyal mkhar rtse'i zil gnon nas 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos sa skyar gnang pa'i phyag bris dngos la zhal bshus bgyis so/ /bkra shis// ༈ //yang sngags 'chang chen po'i rta byag pa la dmigs nas thugs dam gtor ma gnang dus/ nang dus mdzad pa'i thugs dam rnams dmar chen gtor bzlog sgra ji bzhin la/ gtor rgyag gi nyin dgong phyogs/ kyai bso so dang / bka' bsgo nas bzung gtor ma nam theb bar gyi cho ga rnams drug cu ba lugs la 'on kyang gtor 'bul skabs bskang gtor rgyas pa rnams kyang 'bul zhing / dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i bar la zor las pa rnams sngon la phyin nas/ gser skyems/ dpang gzugs/ zor lam dbye ba rnams grub pa byas/ thugs dam pa byin rnams phebs 'phral/ pho nya bskul nas gtor ma 'phang ba mdos chen lugs dang / slar log ste/ sa yul gang 'gab su rol mo bcams nas/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma dbyangs ring thung rnams grub nas/ 'cham mgon rnams ban gtsang pa rnams kyi mgon khang bar phebs skyel mdzad pa zhig byung zhes yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las yang yang thos shing / de dus gsung chog phyag phyi la 'jam dbyangs sku mched gnyis dang / dbu byed bsod nams lha dbang / mchod dpon bzod mchog pa rnams kyang yod pa 'dug pa/ rjes 'jug rnams kyi dgongs 'tshal/ 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dad pa'i dbang gis brjed thor btab pa yin/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dmar chen gtor bzlog gi phyag len grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i phyag bris dngos/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
